title: Sum of Absolute Differences in a Sorted Array
goal: Compute the sum of absolute differences from every value to all other sorted-array values.
strategy: Sorted order lets left differences use value minus earlier entries and right differences use later entries minus value. Prefix totals evaluate both sides without rescanning.
